nodes.klein: to throw, to shake. he shook (in the phrase קִלְקֵל בַּחִצִּים, Ezek. 21:26, ‘he shook the arrows to and fro’, for the sake of divination); he whetted. he moved to and fro (occurring only Jer. 4:24 in the phrase וֽכָל־הַגְּבָעוֹת הִתְקֵלְקָלוּ, ‘and all the hills moved to and fro’).
